ranger_elen.name: Ranger Elen
ranger_elen.motivation: Protect the outpost, stop the corruption, honor ancient watch-oaths she barely understands
ranger_elen.secretNote: Carries an heirloom charm with thorn-crown sigil (matches bell carvings); doesn't know its significance

quartermaster_brann.name: Quartermaster Brann
quartermaster_brann.motivation: Keep the outpost supplied, preserve what records remain
quartermaster_brann.secretNote: Knows the silver bells predate the Rangers; has seen similar harvest-sigils in traveling merchants' wares from the southern vale

trader_sila.name: Trader Sila
trader_sila.motivation: Profit, safety, escape before things get worse
trader_sila.secretNote: Has heard rumors of 'harvest troubles' in villages two days south; assumes it's unrelated

captured_bandit_leader_rusk.name: Captured Bandit Leader Rusk
captured_bandit_leader_rusk.motivation: Survive Malarok's wrath, escape the region
captured_bandit_leader_rusk.secretNote: Genuinely believes Malarok was 'trying to stop something worse'; overheard references to 'debts' and 'the old hunger'

merchant_lira.name: Merchant Lira
merchant_lira.motivation: Escape, warn others about the tribute-gathering
merchant_lira.secretNote: Overheard bandits mention 'gathering tributes for the master's ritual' at a 'forgotten altar'

wounded_scout_neris.name: Wounded Scout Neris
wounded_scout_neris.motivation: Survive, share map intelligence with party
wounded_scout_neris.secretNote: Saw symbols in the corrupted woods matching those on the silver bells—thorn-crown, hollow eye

spirit-touched_hermit_maelo.name: Spirit-Touched Hermit Maelo
spirit-touched_hermit_maelo.motivation: Protect the forest's spiritual balance, atone for failing to stop Malarok earlier
spirit-touched_hermit_maelo.secretNote: Recognized Malarok years ago as 'a man seeking ward-breaking without wrath'; refused to help; knows the iron charm's significance as 'keeper-forged'

malarok_the_corruptor.name: Malarok the Corruptor
malarok_the_corruptor.faction: Independent (former Keeper of the Northern Circle)
malarok_the_corruptor.motivation: Contain the 'old hunger' using the Voidstone, break the ancient debt-cycle by any means
malarok_the_corruptor.secretNote: Was once a warden of the northern druid circle; discovered the 'split covenant' and tried to take the debt's power into himself; failed, corrupted, now genuinely believes the Voidstone is both amplifier AND seal

corrupted_woodland_creatures.name: Corrupted Woodland Creatures
corrupted_woodland_creatures.role: Environmental hazards, evidence of corruption spread

the_withered_hart.name: The Withered Hart
the_withered_hart.motivation: Protect the forest's memory, warn of the broken covenant, serve as witness to the old debt
the_withered_hart.secretNote: Holds fragmented memories of the original keeper circle, the 'southern covenant,' and the pact that split them; if freed, shares visions that point toward other regional mysteries without naming them

narrativeContext.regionalAtmosphere: A day's travel south lies the fertile vale where harvest festivals end in unease. Here in the northern woods, the corruption feels older—like a wound that never fully healed, now tearing open again.
keyMysteries: The silver bells bear symbols no Ranger recognizes, yet their magic still works
Malarok's journals speak of 'debts' and 'covenants' no living person remembers signing
The Voidstone's pulse matches no known magical frequency—except perhaps the rhythm of distant bells on quiet nights

indirectConnections.designPhilosophy: All hints point 'south' and 'harvest' and 'debt' without naming specific places or entities. Players may connect these to other adventures, but nothing is required.
suggestedEchoes: Harvest sigils that resemble those found in distant village records
A 'split covenant' that might parallel other broken pacts
An 'old hunger' that sleeps beneath many lands, not just this one

dmGuidance.moralAmbiguity: Malarok is a tragic figure, not a cackling villain. He chose corruption to stop something worse—but that choice made him the monster. Players may question whether destroying the Voidstone was right.
dmGuidance.puzzleBalance: Lore fragments enhance narrative depth but never block progress. All endings are accessible; only the 'purified_path' and 'witness_path' require optional content.
dmGuidance.horrorTone: Emphasize atmosphere over gore. The horror is existential—broken covenants, forgotten debts, cycles that repeat. Let players fill the gaps with their imagination.

Shadow relic thread echoes in adjacent module lore.
